title: Schedule of Special-Class Sublimits and Property Covered (Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan)
content:
Under the Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan, five classes of stored property carry a sublimit: the most paid for that class in one loss, in USD. General household property has no sublimit of its own; it is limited only by the level's coverage limit.

## Schedule A — Special-class sublimits per loss (USD)

| Coverage level | Jewelry, furs and watches | Electronics | Collectibles, fine art and memorabilia | Firearms | Business inventory, tools and equipment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $2,000 Plan | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $3,000 Plan | 500.00 | 1500.00 | 750.00 | 500.00 | 1500.00 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $5,000 Plan | 750.00 | 2500.00 | 1000.00 | 500.00 | 2500.00 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $7,500 Plan | 1000.00 | 3500.00 | 1500.00 | 1000.00 | 3750.00 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $10,000 Plan | 1000.00 | 5000.00 | 2500.00 | 1000.00 | 5000.00 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $15,000 Plan | 1500.00 | 7500.00 | 3500.00 | 1000.00 | 7500.00 |

## Schedule B — Kinds of property within the plan

| Coverage level | Cash, securities, deeds and personal papers | Household members' property | Property held for someone outside the household | Vehicles, trailers or their contents |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $2,000 Plan | No | Yes | No | No |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $3,000 Plan | No | Yes | No | No |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $5,000 Plan | No | Yes | No | No |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $7,500 Plan | No | Yes | No | No |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $10,000 Plan | No | Yes | No | No |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $15,000 Plan | No | Yes | No | No |

"Yes" means the kind of property is within the plan at that level; "No" means it is not.

## Notes to the schedules

1. The electronics class covers computers, televisions and other electronics.
2. The same firearms sublimit, 500.00, applies at the $2,000, $3,000 and $5,000 levels, and 1000.00 applies at the $7,500, $10,000 and $15,000 levels.
3. Schedule B is identical at all six levels: cash, securities, deeds and personal papers are never within the plan; property of household members stored in the unit is within it; property held for someone outside the household is not; vehicles, trailers and their contents are not.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

On the $3,000 Plan, a loss in which a hypothetical 1,800.00 of electronics is lost meets an electronics sublimit of 1500.00; on the $5,000 Plan the same electronics sit within the sublimit of 2500.00.
